description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Added new built-in Java runtimes: 1.8.0_482, 17.0.21.1, 21.0.13.1 and 25.0.5.1, which are re-unpacked on the next launch
2. Fixed the FFmpeg plugin not being exposed under standard command names: ffmpeg / ffprobe can now be called through PATH inside the game, so mods that probe for them (such as Frameback) work again (#2039)
3. Fixed some built-in MobileGlues options falling back to MG's own defaults; options not configured in the launcher are now written with the launcher defaults
4. Fixed abnormal CPU usage with the frame limiter enabled: the frame limiter wait no longer busy-waits but sleeps with an adaptive spin, so high frame rates still hold the cap (#2036)
5. Optimized the game window to use opaque composition, reducing GPU composition overhead at high frame rates
6. Fixed the mod count in the version list not matching the actual mods; only jar / zip / litemod files are counted now (#2034)
7. Fixed the top of the head being clipped during the jumping hands-up animation in the skin preview

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.新增：内置 Java 运行环境更新至 1.8.0_482、17.0.21.1、21.0.13.1、25.0.5.1，下次启动自动重新解压
2.修复 FFmpeg 插件未以标准命令名暴露的问题：游戏内可通过 PATH 直接调用 ffmpeg / ffprobe，依赖其探测的模组（如 Frameback）恢复可用 (#2039)
3.修复内置 MobileGlues 的部分配置回落到 MG 自身默认值的问题，启动器里未配置过的选项也按启动器默认整份落盘
4.修复开启限帧时的 CPU 异常占用：限帧等待不再忙等，改为休眠加自适应自旋，高帧率下仍能贴住上限 (#2036)
5.优化游戏窗口改为不透明合成，降低高帧率下的 GPU 合成开销
6.修复版本列表中的模组数量与实际不一致的问题，现在只统计 jar / zip / litemod 文件 (#2034)
7.修复皮肤预览中「举手蹦跳」动画跳跃时头顶被裁切的问题
